name: Donald Trump
current_role: 47th President of the United States (since January 20, 2025)
summary: Donald Trump (born 1946) is the 47th president of the United States, in office since January 20, 2025, and was also the 45th president (2017–2021), the second president to serve non-consecutive terms. A New York real estate developer who ran his family's business, renamed the Trump Organization, and hosted NBC's The Apprentice from 2004, he was impeached twice in his first term and acquitted both times. In May 2024 a New York jury convicted him on 34 felony counts of falsifying business records; he was sentenced to an unconditional discharge. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the November 3, 2026 midterms, after which he named Stephen Miller White House chief of staff.

connections.name: Larry Ellison
connections.description: Ellison let Trump's reelection campaign hold a February 2020 fundraiser at his California estate, joined Trump at the White House in January 2025 to launch the Stargate AI venture, and in December 2025 Oracle led the investor group that took over TikTok's U.S. business under a deal Trump backed. NPR and others describe Ellison as a Trump friend.

connections.name: Larry Ellison
connections.description: The Wall Street Journal reported in June 2026, citing people familiar with the fundraising, that Ellison gave about $45 million to a nonprofit backing Trump's 2024 campaign. The gift was not subject to disclosure; FEC filings show no direct donations from Ellison to the campaign or its PACs.

connections.name: David Horowitz
connections.description: Horowitz was a prominent Trump supporter: he endorsed Trump and published Big Agenda: President Trump's Plan to Save America (2017). Critics have called him an intellectual godfather of the Trump administration, partly through his protégé Stephen Miller. No source found documents a direct working relationship between the two men.
